snippet.title: PAC-MAN & Red Bull Special Edition Can Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Power up with the limited edition PAC-MAN Red Bull can! Find special codes under each can tab to unlock Red Bull World Mazes in the PAC-MAN app. Find out more @ https://www.pacman.redbull.com
